name: superb
description: Personal skills for Codex: setup, craft, pipeline, bug-investigate and bug-fix.

interface.shortDescription: Clarify product ideas, run an implementation pipeline, fix bugs from evidence.
interface.longDescription: setup installs and verifies the dependencies the others need. craft turns a vague product idea into a decision-rich brief. pipeline takes an approved brief through planning, implementation, review and fixes. bug-investigate traces a reported bug to file:line evidence and stops there, for when knowing is the deliverable. bug-fix carries that same investigation on to a fix that is not done until a regression test which failed first passes.
defaultPrompt: Set up superb and install what it needs.
Help me turn this product idea into a clear brief.
Run the implementation pipeline for this approved design.
Find out why this is broken.
Find out why this is broken and fix it.
